text: Sea's digital financial services (Monee) revenue increased 60.1%, from US$2.4 billion in 2024 to US$3.8 billion in 2025. This was mainly due to growth of the credit business, as lending activities increased and loans receivable grew from US$4.2 billion (Dec 31, 2024) to US$8.0 billion (Dec 31, 2025). The growth in loans receivable was driven by several factors: growth of the e-commerce (Shopee) platform, deepening penetration of consumer lending activities on the platform, and expansion of credit offerings off the e-commerce platform. Approximately 95% of loans receivable as of December 31, 2025 were attributable to consumer and SME loans [Sea, FY2025, p.100].
